entities.name: Gustavo Rodríguez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gustavo Rodríguez Vega is a Mexican prelate of the Catholic Church who has been archbishop of Yucatán since 2015. He became a bishop in 2001, served for seven years as an auxiliary in Monterrey and seven years as bishop of Nuevo Laredo.
